evidence.quote: ii.Patients must have progressed or shown intolerance to any prior immune checkpoint inhibitors.
However, patients who may continue to be candidates for second line immune check point inhibitors can be enrolled prior to initiation for BRAF gene or MEK inhibitors.
Diagnosed with unresectable, locally advanced, or metastatic solid tumors including ER+ HER2- breast cancer (Cohort 1) or melanoma (Cohort 2)

labels.note: Melanoma cohort after ICI progression; first restaging pending, BRAF therapy not yet given (exception may apply).
